description: This file defines interfaces for the Webpa Abstraction Layer, including functions for getting and setting attribute parameters related to Webpa. It also includes necessary includes and licensing information.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Function to retrieve attribute parameters based on parameter names and counts, populating attribute values, counts, and status arrays.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Function to set attribute values based on provided parameter values and counts, updating status arrays to reflect success or failure.
